{{Top|leg}}
The '''High Fane of Xo''' was a structure that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nuswatta]] and the headquarters of the hierophants of Xo, an ancient religious order that practiced ritual sacrifice. It was [[Battle of Nuswatta|destroyed]] by the troops of [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] during [[Xer VIII]]'s consolidation of power within the [[Kingdom of Cron]] and the theocracy was converted to Xer's service.

After the defeat of Xim at the [[Third Battle of Vontor]], the [[Hutt Empire]] began a genocidal campaign against the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] in the [[Ash Worlds/Legends|Kiirium Reaches]] in [[24,500 BBY]]. Fearing imminent destruction, the hierophants fled Nuswatta to found a new stronghold where they would await the climactic battle between [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] that they believed would usher in the end of time and the Perfection of Xo. The Tionese never heard from them again.
